name: Big Evolution Pill
card_text: After this card's activation, it remains on the field, but destroy it during your opponent's 3rd End Phase. Tribute 1 Dinosaur monster to activate this card; while this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon Level 5 or higher Dinosaur monsters without Tributing.
available_set: LEGENDARY COLLECTION 4 JOEY'S WORLD MEGA PACK
